Definition: of foreign origin; Galatia, a region of Asia:--Galatia.
BiblicalUsage: Galatia is the region of Asia Minor where Paul planted churches. He writes to all the brethren with him, unto the churches of Galatia, in Galatians 1:2, and he gives the Corinthians the same order he gave the churches of Galatia about the collection for the saints in 1 Corinthians 16:1. The region is known for its churches and its troubles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Galatia shows how quickly a church can drift. Paul planted it, wrote to it twice, and still had to plead with it not to leave the gospel; I hold that every church needs the letter to the Galatians read aloud again.
